forwards.prompt: A high-quality studio photograph of a small painted tin toy robot standing upright on two broad rectangular feet. It has a silver cylindrical head, two round dark eyes, a square blue torso and simple red articulated arms hanging at its sides. Its full body is visible in a slightly turned pose against a plain light gray backdrop. The metal has subtle scratches and realistic highlights without heavy rust. Softbox lighting, believable joints and balanced proportions, no extra limbs, no text and no recognizable franchise.

A museum-style photograph of one handmade white ceramic bird sculpture with a rounded body, a short beak and a smoothly raised tail. It rests securely on two simple integrated feet on a pale oak shelf. Three-quarter view reveals the entire object and a softly speckled matte glaze with minor handmade irregularities. A warm gray plaster wall fills the uncluttered background. Gentle directional window light casts one short shadow beneath the sculpture. Restrained composition, plausible solid construction, no second bird, flowers, text or decorative labels.

A studio still-life photograph of a tall transparent pale amber glass pitcher standing alone on a dark blue cloth-covered table. The pitcher has a wide circular base, a narrow neck, a clear curved handle and a small pouring lip. A small amount of water rests at the bottom, with physically plausible refraction and controlled soft reflections. Side light from a large window outlines the complete silhouette against a muted gray background. Careful material detail, stable contact shadow, no hands, logos, fruit or additional vessels.

A realistic photograph of a small carved basalt turtle sculpture displayed on a low sandstone pedestal. The complete animal is visible from above and to the front, including a domed segmented shell, four broad short feet, a small head and a tapered tail. Fine tool marks and subtle variations in dark stone texture are visible without excessive gloss. Diffuse gallery lighting creates gentle shadows and a neutral warm background. The sculpture is a single solid object with believable proportions, no lettering, people or additional artifacts.
